title: Constructible pro-étale sheaves are classical
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a discrete Noetherian ring, $X$ a quasi-compact and
quasi-separated scheme, and $F$ a $\Lambda_X$-module sheaf on $X_{\Proet}$ for which
there is a partition $X=Z_1\sqcup\dots\sqcup Z_n$ into constructible locally
closed subsets such that each restriction $F|_{Z_k}$ to $(Z_k)_{\Proet}$ (reduced
structure) is locally constant of finite type. Then $F$ is classical. The same
holds if such a partition exists only locally on $X$.

proof.text: Restrict scalars along the canonical constant-ring unit using the proved encoding. On each slice its constantComparisonHom identifies the intrinsic constant model with the ordinary constant module sheaf, preserving the actual module M. A finite module over the lifted Noetherian ring is finitely presented. Apply finiteLocalSystemsTwist to deduce classicality of each stratum. Scalar restriction preserves the underlying set sheaf, so isClassicalModule_iff identifies the two classicality predicates.

Use proEtaleModuleRestriction_pullback_of_isIso to identify the encoded intrinsic stratum restriction with fixed-module inverse image. The classical essential-image criterion turns stratum classicality into essential-image membership. Apply the proved comparison_essImage_of_stratification: its strong induction uses affine shrinking, the open-closed exact sequence, comparison for extension by zero and closed direct image, extension closure, and Zariski locality. This preserves the unit route and works for every commutative coefficient ring. Supply the canonical coefficient-map IsIso instance from [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], imported only by this item.

For locally given stratifications the same proved argument applies on each given open scheme, without ambient qcqs hypotheses. The canonical pullback composition isomorphism identifies its iterated stratum restriction with the displayed composite immersion. Restrict this isomorphism to each slice and compose it with the supplied constant-model isomorphism. Encode the resulting local classicality, identify open inverse image with openImmersionRestriction, and apply proEtaleClassical_zariskiLocal. Finally return to intrinsic classicality. Supply the canonical coefficient-map IsIso instance from [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], imported only by this item.

lean.statement: theorem constructible_isClassicalModule (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (Λ : Type u) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ] (F : ringedSiteModules.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRing X Λ))) (S : Scheme.Stratification X) (_hred : ∀ k : Fin S.n, IsReduced (S.domain k)) (_hmodels : ∀ k : Fin S.n, ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (V : I → (S.domain k).ProEt) (f : ∀ a : I, V a ⟶ Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 (S.domain k))), Presieve.ofArrows V f ∈ (Scheme.ProEt.precoverage (S.domain k)).coverings _ ∧ ∀ a : I, ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ), Module.Finite (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ) M ∧ Nonempty ((Scheme.proEtaleConstantModulePullback (S.immersion k) Λ F).over (V a) ≅ Scheme.proEtaleConstantModuleSheafOver (S.domain k) Λ (V a) M)) : IsClassicalModule Λ F
lean.note: Two statements, respectively the global finite-partition assertion and its Zariski-local variant. Classicality is the recorded continuity-map predicate for intrinsic constant-ring modules. The existing Stratification includes constructibility in its inherited current Topology.Stratification; its reduced immersed domains realize the reduced induced strata. Finite type is stated by finitely generated constant models on a pro-etale trivializing cover. No finite coefficient ring or reduced ambient scheme is assumed.
